$schema_note: THE ONLY PLACE VENUE FACTS LIVE. Every page is generated from this file.
SOURCING RULE — a field is filled in only when it is stated on the venue's own
website. Anything not confirmed there stays null, and the templates render it as
'Not published' with a link to the official page. Third-party listing sites and
photographer blogs are NOT acceptable sources: they go stale, they disagree with
each other, and publishing their numbers as fact misleads couples about a real
business.
The records below carry only what the venue's own site is known to publish:
name, location, venue type and the official events URL. Capacity, pricing and
layout are null because they were not verified against the primary source.
Fill them in — and set last_verified — as you check each one.
FIELDS
slug            URL segment, stable, never reused
name            the venue's own name for the space
city/state      as the venue states it
state_slug      matches the state page URL; 'italy' for the destination hub
type            greenhouse | conservatory | palm-house | orangery | atrium |
botanical-garden | limonaia
official_url    the venue's own weddings/events page — required
capacity_seated integer, seated with a dance floor, or null
price_tier      1-4 ($ to $$$$) from the venue's published rate, or null
blend           enclosed | hybrid | openair, or null
summary         one factual sentence; no adjectives you cannot source
last_verified   ISO date you last checked official_url, or null
